digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V, App. VI

teaser.en: The 'female spirit-being': one of a family of aromatic-rooted shrubs named after the spirits they are used against.
teaser.sw: 'Kiumbe-roho wa kike': mmoja wa kundi la vichaka vyenye mizizi yenye harufu, vilivyopewa majina ya pepo ambao hutumika dhidi yao.
teaser.dg: 'Pepho wa chichetu': mmwenga wa kundi ra vitsaka vyenye mizi ya arufu nono, vinavyoihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho ambao vinahumirwa kuazuwiya.

summary.en: Mwangajine mchetu is Polyalthia stuhlmannii, a coastal forest shrub of the custard-apple family. It is the 'female' member of the Mwangajine group, plants named after spirits and valued in treating spiritual ailments.
summary.sw: Mwangajine mchetu ni Polyalthia stuhlmannii, kichaka cha misitu ya pwani cha familia ya mitopetope. Ni mwanachama wa 'kike' wa kundi la Mwangajine, mimea iliyopewa majina ya pepo na inayothaminiwa katika kutibu maradhi ya kiroho.
summary.dg: Mwangajine mchetu ni Polyalthia stuhlmannii, chitsaka cha matsaka ga pwani cha jamii ya *custard apple*. Ni 'mchetu' wa kundi ra Mwangajine, mimea iriyoihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho na yenye samani kpwa kuphoza makongo ga pepho.

about.en: Mwangajine mchetu is a shrub or small tree of the custard-apple family, with alternate, smooth, elliptic leaves in two neat rows along the twigs. The Digo identify it by its leaves and its roots, especially the smell of the root. Pakia suggests it is called female because its leaves are smaller than those of the other Mwangajine plants.
about.sw: Mwangajine mchetu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mitopetope, wenye majani laini ya umbo la duaradufu yanayopishana, yaliyopangwa safu mbili nadhifu kando ya vitawi. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na mizizi yake, hasa harufu ya mzizi. Pakia anapendekeza kwamba unaitwa wa kike kwa sababu majani yake ni madogo kuliko yale ya mimea mingine ya Mwangajine.
about.dg: Mwangajine mchetu ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya *custard apple*. Makodzage ni laini na ga mviringo, na ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kubadilishana uphande, mistari miiri sawa-sawa kanda-kanda ya maphungo. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na miziye, zaidi arufu ya muzi. Pakia anagomba kukala anji phahi unaihwa mchetu kpwa sababu makodzage ni madide kuriko ga mimea yanjina ya Mwangajine.

where.en: It grows in the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

uses.en: Pakia does not record a separate use for this species. The unmarked Mwangajine (Isolona cauliflora) is named for its importance as a medicine for spiritual ailments, and Mwangajine mchetu is also identified with that name.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi tofauti ya spishi hii. Mwangajine usio na kivumishi (Isolona cauliflora) umepewa jina kutokana na umuhimu wake kama dawa ya maradhi ya kiroho, na Mwangajine mchetu pia hutambulishwa kwa jina hilo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga tafwauti ga aina ihi. Mwangajine bila neno ranjina (Isolona cauliflora) ukaihwa dzina hiro kpwa sababu ya samaniye dza dawa ya makongo ga pepho, na Mwangajine mchetu piya nkuihwa kpwa dzina hiro.

culture.en: Mwanga and jine are both names of spirits. Pakia explains that the Mwangajine plants are named after these spirits because they are used against the ailments the spirits cause, and takes such names as evidence of how strongly Digo life involves belief in spirits and magico-medicine.
culture.sw: Mwanga na jine yote ni majina ya pepo. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mimea ya Mwangajine imepewa majina ya pepo hawa kwa sababu hutumika dhidi ya maradhi wanayoyasababisha, na anayachukulia majina kama hayo kuwa ushahidi wa jinsi imani ya pepo na tiba za kiuchawi zilivyokita mizizi katika maisha ya Wadigo.
culture.dg: Mwanga na jine gosi mairi ni madzina ga pepho. Pakia anagomba kukala mimea ya Mwangajine ikaihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho hao kpwa sababu nkuhumirwa kuphoza makongo ganayorehwa ni pepho hao. Anahala madzina dza higa dza ushahidi wa vira imani ya pepho na dawa za uganga vinavyoinjira sana maisha ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwangajine mchetu, 'female spirit-being'. It is the female partner of Mwangajine mlume, the 'male spirit-being' (Uvariodendron kirkii), and is also sometimes simply called Mwangajine, the name of Isolona cauliflora. Its scientific name is Polyalthia stuhlmannii.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwangajine mchetu, 'kiumbe-roho wa kike'. Ni mwenzi wa kike wa Mwangajine mlume, 'kiumbe-roho wa kiume' (Uvariodendron kirkii), na wakati mwingine huitwa tu Mwangajine, jina la Isolona cauliflora. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Polyalthia stuhlmannii.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwangajine mchetu, 'pepho wa chichetu'. Myawe wa chilume ni Mwangajine mlume, 'pepho wa chilume' (Uvariodendron kirkii). Wakati wanjina piya nkuihwa Mwangajine tu, dzina ra Isolona cauliflora. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Polyalthia stuhlmannii.

reason.dg: Mwangajine bila neno ra chilume au chichetu

reason.dg: Muhi wanjina unaoihwa kpwa dzina ra pepho Mwanga
